note: Compile errors the build repairs itself, and ones it reports. 'verifiedOn' lists where the repair was seen working; a real phone is only listed when the user confirmed it.

errors.rootCause: A statement follows one that always leaves the method/loop (return/throw/break, or a try whose every path returns).
errors.repair: GENERATED_CODE_REWRITE: wrap the statement in front in if (true) { } (kept code, void contexts) or remove the dead statements (value-returning methods, or when keeping doesn't compile). Line count never changes.
errors.scope: generated sources of this build only; blocks unchanged; re-applied at every build
verifiedOn: user's phone, v1.8.0: project #644 (Vehicle Parking) built, installed and started (reported 2026-10-04)
errors.permanent: v1.8.1: when the repaired lines lie inside one add-source-directly block, the compile log offers Apply to block; storing is proved by regenerating the activity.

errors.fingerprint: ECJ: X cannot be resolved to a type / The import X cannot be resolved
errors.rootCause: Missing import, or the library that has the class isn't enabled for the project.
errors.repair: IMPORT_SYNTHESIS (class found on the build classpath) or DEPENDENCY_RESOLUTION (enable the installed local library; download a known coordinate from Google Maven / Maven Central / JitPack; link its sub-dependencies).
verifiedOn: Android 12 ART (API 31) x86_64 for the offline steps; downloads on JVM 17 only (the sandbox kernel has no IPv6, so the Android runtime cannot open sockets there)

errors.fingerprint: ECJ: Syntax error, insert ";" / Type mismatch: cannot convert from double to int / Unreachable catch block
errors.repair: GENERATED_CODE_REWRITE: add the semicolon / add the narrowing cast / remove the catch block.

errors.fingerprint: AAPT2: 'PNG chunk type 49444154 is too large' then 'Exit code 139' (segmentation fault)
errors.rootCause: A PNG that is cut off or has damaged data. The shipped static aapt2 crashes on it; with damaged pixel data it crashes without naming the file.
errors.repair: PngSanitizer: structure check of every PNG before 'aapt2 compile'; after a failure a thorough check (checksums, pixel data size). The damaged image is replaced by a valid PNG that keeps the readable rows, in the build's copy (or in a copy of the folder for imported and library resources). The user's image is not changed. Only drawable*/mipmap* folders are checked (res/raw is copied verbatim by AAPT2 and left alone). With checksum damage the rows below the damaged spot can be wrong, and the warning says so.
verifiedOn: JVM 17 with the shipped x86_64 aapt2: crash reproduced (exit 139) and gone after the repair, for cut-off RGBA/RGB/gray/palette/gray+alpha PNGs, a wrong-checksum PNG and a non-PNG file; independent review ran 117 valid PNGs of every type with no false alarm and 850 salvaged outputs that all open
notVerifiedOn: interlaced PNGs (handed to BitmapFactory, which cannot run off-device)

errors.fingerprint: ECJ: X cannot be resolved + warning 'Local library ... is enabled but its classes.jar is missing'
errors.rootCause: The project's library list points to a library folder whose classes.jar is gone (folder deleted, moved, or only partly restored).
errors.repair: LibraryIntegrity at build start: restore from an .aar/.jar left in the folder; else download the same library again, but only when its coordinate is certain (recorded at install in source.json, or a well-known library with exactly that folder name). A name is never looked up in a repository: look-alike artifacts exist under popular names (found in review: appcompat, recyclerview, exoplayer under foreign groups on Maven Central). Only missing files are added; res, manifest and config in the folder are kept. A failed download is not retried for 5 minutes.
verifiedOn: JVM 17 with network: AestheticDialogs 1.0.0 from JitPack (folder gone; folder with edited res/config kept unchanged); unknown names and appcompat/recyclerview look-alikes refused without download; path-like names skipped; resource-only library left alone; jar present but dex missing -> dex made
Android 12 ART (API 31) x86_64: restore from an .aar in the folder incl. D8, then the project compiled
notVerifiedOn: the AAPT2 resource step for the restored library

errors.fingerprint: D8 3.3.75 (bundled): NullPointerException while dexing androidx.concurrent:concurrent-futures >= 1.2.0 or com.google.errorprone:error_prone_annotations >= 2.48
errors.rootCause: Class files of these releases (newer javac output) crash the D8 the IDE ships. Seen while preparing the v1.8.3 built-in libraries, not in a user project.
errors.repair: none in the build: the built-in set keeps concurrent-futures 1.1.0 and leaves error_prone_annotations / jspecify out (annotation-only, not needed at run time). A local library that pulls these versions fails the same way in DEX; use an older version of that dependency.
verifiedOn: JVM 17 with the D8 3.3.75 classes from the IDE (tools/builtin-libs/package.py)

errors.repair: none yet; the harness fixtures leave the widget out. Seen on the Android 12 ART harness, not reported from the phone.

errors.fingerprint: Generated app with min SDK < 21 on Android 4.x: ClassNotFoundException for <package>.SketchApplication at start
errors.rootCause: Upstream merge order: MultiDex, then every library, then the project's own DEX last. Once the libraries pass 64K methods (v1.8.3 AppCompat projects do), the project's classes land in classes3.dex, and Android 4.x loads only classes.dex before MultiDex.install().
errors.repair: v1.8.3 Dp.getDexFilesReady: with min SDK < 21 the project's DEX files are merged right after MultiDex (fixture 907: classes.dex holds MultiDex, MultiDexApplication, SketchApplication, MainActivity). Min SDK 21+ unchanged.
verifiedOn: Android 12 ART (API 31) x86_64 harness: build and class placement only. Not run on Android 4.x.

errors.rootCause: DexMerger reserved 2x the input's debug info; a 1-byte string/type index becomes 3 bytes when the merged DEX has 16384+ strings. Seen when the project's small DEX was merged into classes.dex with the libraries (min SDK < 21).
errors.repair: v1.8.3: 3x + 8 bytes reserved (an upper bound for index growth); the merger compacts unused space afterwards.
